description: The small-order-R forgery copied from crates/polyjose/tests/jws_eddsa.rs (SMALL_ORDER_R_FORGERY, payload "forged") with the RFC 8037 A.2 public key: R is the identity point and S = k·a mod L, so the cofactorless RFC 8032 §5.1.7 equation [S]B = R + [k]A holds (checked independently with the RFC 8032 §6 reference Python arithmetic), but strict verification (verify_strict) refuses a small-order R
